title: partnerships-marketplace-daily-notes-jordan-4
content:
Daily scratchpad - Marketplace partnerships (Jordan)

Context:
- Quick notes from partner syncs and next steps for integrations pipeline. Mostly reminders and short TODOs.
- Partners: AcmeSearch, DataBridge, WidgetCorp (pilot).

Top priorities for this week:
1) AcmeSearch onboarding
   - Confirm API key rotation schedule (ask security).
   - Get sample dataset (50k tokens) for inference perf test.
   - Run baseline latency test with small-batch config; record results in shared spreadsheet.
   - TODO: follow up with Priya (Acme) about GDPR PII fields mapping (due Fri).

2) DataBridge connector
   - Integration checklist:
     - [ ] Auth flow tested (OAuth client id/secret)
     - [ ] Rate limits documented/negotiated
     - [ ] Schema mapping doc from partner (expected by Wed)
     - [ ] Add endpoint to staging routing and smoke test
   - Note: need infra ticket to increase request quota for staging (REQ-889).
   - Blocker: partner uses cursor-based pagination—need small change to ingestion adapter (assign to @ashley).

3) WidgetCorp pilot prep
   - Deliverables for pilot: 2 model variants (quantized + full), demo prompt set, success metrics (latency <= 250ms p95, cost <$0.004/token).
   - Action: draft SOW runbook for pilot (include rollback plan and termination criteria).

Meeting notes (2025-02-11 partner sync):
- Acme: prioritize perf over small model accuracy for first 2 weeks. Suggest using caching prefix for repeated queries.
- DataBridge: wants weekly sync; proposed Wed 10am PT.
- WidgetCorp: asked for estimated timeline — we gave 3 weeks for initial pilot.

Integration checklist reminders (internal):
- Security & Compliance:
  - Ensure KMS key association present in Private deployments page for this partner.
  - Audit logs enabled and forwarded to partner-specified destination (if requested).
- Observability:
  - Add per-route latency dashboard for partner route; include token-level cost breakdowns.
  - Create alert on p95 latency > 300ms for first 2 weeks of pilot.
- Runtime config:
  - Batching recommended: start with batch_size=8, max_duration_ms=40; adjust after perf run.
  - Quantization profile: fp16 fallback if int8 shows quality regression on pass 1 evals.

Quick reminders & follow-ups:
- Email Priya (Acme) re: sample dataset and mapping (due 2025-02-14).
- Create staging infra ticket for DataBridge quota (REQ-889) and assign to infra on-call.
- Draft pilot SOW for WidgetCorp and share with legal for standard terms (LOI?).
- Add short eval prompt set to repo: github.com/redwood-inference/partner-evals/widgetcorp (PR pending).

Notes to self:
- Keep notes brief in drive; move polished process docs to Confluence after pilot kickoff.
- Capture perf numbers in sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/marketplace-perf (copy to partner folder).
- If model fallback is used, log counts to partner route for billing reconciliation.

End-of-day quick log (2025-02-12):
- Ran small-batch perf for Acme: p50=120ms, p95=310ms (high) -> investigate network variance + try batch_size=4.
- Spoke with Ashley re: DataBridge adapter changes; she will open PR and tag infra.
- Drafted SOW outline (50%); need legal review.

Unresolved questions:
- Acme wants SLA language around p95; do we include guaranteed p95 in pilot SLA? Check with CS/legal.
- WidgetCorp: expected peak QPS unknown; ask for traffic profile.

Next syncs:
- Wed 10am PT: DataBridge weekly (set calendar invite).
- Fri 2pm PT: internal pre-pilot review (include infra, legal, observability).

---
Scratch/todo quick list:
- [ ] Email Priya (Acme)
- [ ] Open staging quota ticket (REQ-889)
- [ ] Review Ashley PR for DB adapter
- [ ] Finish SOW draft + send to legal
- [ ] Create perf dashboard skeleton

(End)
